description_en: You can invoke the ListAgentStates API to retrieve a list of agent statuses under a specified instance, filtered by specified conditions. This API is available only to specific Users. Other Customers are not recommended to invoke it
description_zh: 调用ListAgentStates获取指定实例下按指定条件过滤后的坐席状态列表，该接口仅对特定用户开放，其他客户不建议调用
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-agent-states --instance-id ccc-test --skill-group-id skillgroup@ccc-test --agent-ids agent@ccc-test --state Ready --page-number 1 --page-size 100 --exclude-offline-users true --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAgentStates

parameters.description_en: Filters by a list of agent IDs.
parameters.help_en: Filters by a list of agent IDs
parameters.name: agent_ids

parameters.description_en: Filters agents by status. Only a single status can be specified.
parameters.description_zh: 按坐席状态过滤，只能按单个状态过滤。
parameters.help_en: Filters agents by status. Only a single status can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 按坐席状态过滤，只能按单个状态过滤
parameters.name: state

parameters.description_en: Filters out offline agents. This parameter is fixed to true and does not support false at present.
parameters.description_zh: 过滤掉离线坐席，固定为true，暂不支持false。
parameters.help_en: Filters out offline agents. This parameter is fixed to true and does not support false at present
parameters.help_zh: 过滤掉离线坐席，固定为true，暂不支持false
parameters.name: exclude_offline_users
